task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight CA1234 and get information about the Hilton Tokyo. Then, check Alice's calendar availability on October 24, 2024, find her first available time slot, and email her that start time using "Hilton Tokyo" as the subject. Finally, send her a high-priority push alert via the app with the message that the email was sent successfully.
